candidates.source_name: MNB Közzétételek – Officially Appointed Mechanism (OAM) for regulated information
candidates.why_relevant: Hungary's statutory central storage mechanism under the Transparency Directive, operated by Magyar Nemzeti Bank. Every public securities issuer (incl. OTP, MBH, Erste HU bond issuers, MKB/Takarék entities, investment firms, fund managers) files regulated information here: annual/interim reports, inside information, Pillar 3 disclosures, major-holdings and manager-transaction notifications. Enumerating its issuer index yields a near-complete register of Hungarian banking/payments issuers that publish continuously.
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector information published under statutory obligation (Tpt. 2001. évi CXX. tv. 56. §)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the entity-category indexes then the per-issuer disclosure lists; documents fetchable via the observed download endpoint pattern /downloadkozzetetel?id=<id>&did=<docid>. No documented API or bulk export — plan polite paginated crawling with change detection.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from ESMA OAM framing
queries_used: kozzetetelek.mnb.hu tőkepiaci közzétételek kereső szabályozott információ
Hungary officially appointed mechanism OAM regulated information storage ESMA list MNB

candidates.source_name: Elektronikus Beszámoló Portál (e-beszámoló, Igazságügyi Minisztérium)
candidates.why_relevant: Every Hungarian Zrt/Kft/Nyrt must deposit its statutory annual accounts here. This is the single highest-leverage source for the long tail of the payments ecosystem: PSP subsidiaries, ATM/cash-in-transit operators, POS and terminal vendors' Hungarian entities, fintech Kft-s, savings cooperatives — entities that have no IR site at all. Filings include mérleg, eredménykimutatás, kiegészítő melléklet and auditor's report.
candidates.access_status: free public, no registration required for search/download
candidates.legal_status: public register under the Accounting Act (2000. évi C. tv.) and Ctv.; bulk dataset also sold commercially by the operator
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted lookups by cégjegyzékszám / first 8 digits of adószám / company name (min. 4 chars) via the beszámoló kereső, then PDF download. For systematic coverage consider the operator's paid bulk 'beszámoló állomány' offering instead of mass scraping.

negative_findings.description: Neither the MNB OAM (kozzetetelek.mnb.hu) introduction/documentation nor the e-beszámoló portal documents any public API, RSS feed or bulk export for regulated filings; the OAM introduction page describes only print/save and form-field search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection from both statutory repositories will require HTML scraping (OAM shows a per-document endpoint pattern /downloadkozzetetel?id=&did=) or, for e-beszámoló, a paid bulk licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Materially raises collection cost and fragility for the two most important sources in this cell; argues for early procurement talks with the e-beszámoló operator and for scraper monitoring on the OAM.

negative_findings.description: The BÉT kibocsátói hírek page as fetched showed no visible RSS/Atom link, pagination controls or archive-depth indicator.
negative_findings.result_summary: Archive depth and feed availability for bet.hu issuer announcements are unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If historical announcements are not deep-linkable, backfill may have to come from the MNB OAM instead, with bet.hu used only for near-real-time monitoring.

negative_findings.description: The Cégközlöny appears under several hostnames in current references — cegkozlony.hu, cegportal.im.gov.hu/frontend/cegkozlony and the older e-cegkozlony.gov.hu — and e-beszámoló returned 404 pages for the legacy path /oldal/kereses_merleglista. Likewise njt.hu and njt.jog.gov.hu both appear live.
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical hosts and stable deep-link paths for the gazette and for some e-beszámoló search endpoints are not settled from search results alone; these are unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors keyed on the wrong host or a legacy path will silently break; a deterministic liveness pass must resolve the canonical entry points before build.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian-language term or portal was found for a consolidated national XBRL/ESEF filing viewer analogous to some other EU OAMs; ESEF filings appear to sit inside the general OAM document store rather than in a dedicated structured-data facility.
negative_findings.result_summary: Structured (iXBRL) extraction of HU issuer financials may need per-document handling rather than a national structured feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects feasibility of automated financial-line-item extraction for listed HU banks; ESAP may resolve this later.

negative_findings.description: The free e-cégjegyzék company information is explicitly labelled informational ('tájékoztató jellegű') and is refreshed only when registered data change, so the extract's validity date can lag by more than a week.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free register data is not suitable as an authoritative point-in-time record.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership/board changes in payments entities may be detected late; time-critical work should use OCCSZ or Cégközlöny notices instead.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each for the earliest retrievable item to size backfill; Aranykönyv is confirmed to reach back to roughly 2003 and can anchor long time series.

brief: Hungary concentrates statutory disclosure in a small, highly enumerable set of state-run repositories: the MNB's officially appointed mechanism at kozzetetelek.mnb.hu (all regulated issuer information incl. Pillar 3 and inside information), the Ministry of Justice e-beszámoló portal (annual accounts of literally every Zrt/Kft, hence the whole long tail of PSPs, ATM operators and vendor subsidiaries), the Cégközlöny gazette and e-cégjegyzék for corporate events and identity, and BÉT for listed-issuer announcements. Two MNB assets multiply the leverage: Intézménykereső, the authoritative register of every licensed bank, payment institution and e-money issuer, and the Aranykönyv, which publishes per-institution standardised financials back to roughly 2003 in xlsx and interactive form — a ready-made comparable dataset that avoids filing-level parsing. The binding constraint is machine access, not availability: none of the core repositories documents an API, RSS or bulk export, e-beszámoló sells its bulk corpus commercially, and several hosts (Cégközlöny, njt) exist under competing domains, so canonical-endpoint resolution and a robots/terms review must precede any collector build. Local-language terms are mandatory throughout — közzététel, szabályozott információ, nyilvánosságra hozatal, beszámoló/mérleg letétbe helyezés, kibocsátói hírek — since English mirrors, where they exist, are partial.
